description.narrative:
The objective of the intervention is to strengthen independent media organizations in Bosnia and Herzegovina, particularly in the Republika Srpska entity, by enhancing their organizational, managerial, and editorial capacities to ensure sustainable, transparent, and high-quality media production.
By the end of the intervention, it is expected that:
Targeted investigative media outlets, will have further developed and implemented comprehensive internal policies and procedures that improve their governance, financial management, and editorial practices.
All outlets will be better equipped to resist political pressure, navigate restrictive legal environments, and maintain independent and fact-based reporting.
Sida assesses that the intervention will result in increased production of high-quality investigative content, improved public awareness of media freedom issues, and strengthened advocacy efforts for media rights and freedom of expression.
A more resilient, transparent, and professional media environment will contribute to democratic governance, public accountability, and civic engagement in BiH.
